text:
maria: Getting a weird spike — several high-sev alerts didn't page the on-call and the #incidents thread didn't get automation posts. Anyone else seeing paging failures? :rotating_light:

opsbot: deploy-notify-proxy finished: success (22m ago) — notify-proxy@prod v2.14.3

leo: I'm pulling proxy logs now. Seeing a bunch of 403s from the pager service when trying to forward:
```
2026-03-17T14:03:21Z notify-proxy -> pagerflow POST /v1/pages 403 {"error":"signature mismatch"}
2026-03-17T14:03:22Z notify-proxy -> pagerflow POST /v1/pages 403 {"error":"signature mismatch"}
```

sam: Confirmed — oncall-bot shows "page attempted" events but no outbound delivery. Phones didn't ring.

oncall-bot: Delivery failed to +1-555-0101: 403 Forbidden (HMAC auth failed).

jess: I'm starting manual escalation to the on-call list and touching base with support for customer impact.

leo: Quick dump of headers from notify-proxy -> pagerflow:
```
Authorization: HMAC-SHA256 signature=abc123...
X-Notify-Timestamp: 1679000000
```
Pagerflow rejects with: `{"message":"invalid signature","code":403}`

maria: How long has this been happening?

leo: Earliest 403 we see ~14:01 UTC. Looks like token rotation ran ~13:59 UTC per ops rotation logs.

deploy-bot: rotation-script v1.8 executed on notify-proxy at 2026-03-17T13:59:02Z by ops/rotation-batch.

sam: Are we able to re-run with previous signing key to restore paging?

leo: Trying a replay with the old key now...

opsbot: replay webhook attempt using legacy key -> 200 OK (pagerflow accepted).

maria: Okay that proves rotation is the trigger. Jess, can you confirm customer impact numbers?

jess: Support report: 18 customer alerts that should've paged in the window 13:59–14:20 UTC. Two customers reported missed on-call notifications and opened support tickets. We'll collect full list and affected teams.

sre_lead: Immediate mitigation: revert rotation for notify-proxy and re-deploy old signing key, enable fallback route to sms-gateway v1.1. I'll own the rollback.

leo: Reverted signing_key -> notify-proxy picked up old key. Pagerflow acceptance confirmed, outgoing pages resumed at ~14:06 UTC. Switching to fallback SMS now as hedge.

maria: Timeline we should capture: rotation at 13:59 -> pages failed 14:01–14:06 -> manual revert + replay -> pages resumed 14:06 -> follow-ups ongoing.

jess: Customer comms in progress: proactive emails to affected customers with summary and mitigation steps, offering incident call if they want.

sre_lead: Post-incident action items (quick list):
1) Revisit rotation playbook: add canary smoke for paging endpoints before rolling keys.
2) Add automated verification that pagerflow accepts a signed test page after rotation.
3) Improve oncall-bot visibility: surface "delivery failed" to #incidents as an automated ephemeral alert and page secondary oncall.
4) Run audit of rotation-script for ordering bug that replaced both old and new keys before blacklisting old key.

leo: Reproducer notes attached inline: rotation script currently writes new key then updates registry and sets expiry. Need add a step to validate acceptance at pagerflow before expiring old key.

sam: I've started a manual ticket for policy change and added myself as owner for the rotation smoke tests.

maria: Anything pending to keep services stable for the rest of the day?

opsbot: Temporary mitigation enabled: fallback-route=sms-gateway-v1.1, rotation-rollbacks=on, notify-proxy healthcheck=enabled.

jess: Support will follow up with the 2 customers who already pinged us and update the support tickets.

sre_lead: Thanks all. We'll do a short retro in 30m to capture details and assign owners for the longer-term fixes. If anyone finds additional affected customers, drop them here. :white_check_mark:
